title: Agentmon
tagline: Befriend creatures and relight the six Beacons.
shortDescription: Join the Field Agent Academy, make friends with 52 cute creatures and solve puzzle Trials to clear the static fog. A gentle pixel-art adventure where nobody gets hurt.
longDescription: Agentmon is a creature-befriending pixel-art adventure for ages 7 to 12. New Field Agents explore the Sunreach region, from a sunny coast to a sky island, and make friends with 52 original Agentmon in a little timing game, never by catching them. Friends spar in calm turn-based battles where a tired creature simply takes a nap. Puzzle Trials with blocks, ice, mirrors and color gates lead to the six Beacons that push back a strange static fog. Read-aloud dialogue, hints, three difficulty levels and a Field Guide full of real nature facts make it easy to play and learn.
features: 52 original creatures to befriend with a timing or mood game
Friendly turn-based sparring where nobody gets hurt
Six puzzle Trials with blocks, ice, mirrors and color gates
A Field Guide with a real nature fact for every creature
Read-aloud dialogue, hints and three difficulty levels
Three save slots that stay in this browser
contentNotes: Gentle sparring only: tired creatures take a nap and are never hurt or lost. Losing sends you to a Rest Stop with nothing taken. No purchases, ads, chat or random reward packs. Some reading, with read-aloud. Saves stay in this browser.

quickStart: Press Play, pick a slot and make your Field Agent.
Walk with the touch stick, the arrow keys or a gamepad, or tap where you want to go.
Press A to talk, spar and befriend; B goes back.
howToPlay: Walk with WASD or the arrow keys (hold X to hurry), a gamepad stick or d-pad, the touch stick, or tap or click a spot to walk there. Tap a person or a door to walk up to it.
A (Z, Space or Enter; gamepad A; the A button) talks, picks and confirms. B (X, Escape or Backspace; gamepad B; the B button) goes back.
Menu (M or Tab; gamepad Start; the Menu button) opens your team, bag, Field Guide, map, quests, the Agent Base and settings.

In a spar, pick a move (the star is a good pick), Rest to get energy back, or Befriend a tired wild Agentmon. In the Spark Ring, tap or press A when the spark is in the pink glow, or switch to Mood Match in Settings.
In Trials, walk into blocks to push them. Press R or open the Trial menu to reset a room.
